name: scoutdesk
description: Football video scouting & match analysis workstation

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server && npm run seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
